## Result and milestone

State the concrete behavior and the authorized milestone.

## Base version and scope

Record the accepted base commit/tag, changed modules and ownership. Explain any
change to previously verified code. Record ABI/EIP-712/events/hash/enum changes.

## Verification

Paste the exact command, test count and CI result. Distinguish mocks from real
integration. Include known failures and unresolved assumptions.

## User acceptance

- [ ] CEO technical review completed.
- [ ] User has explicitly accepted this milestone/merge.
- [ ] A rollback commit/tag is recorded; earlier versions remain unchanged.
- [ ] A new version and affected team interfaces are documented.

After reporting, stop. A merged milestone does not authorize the next milestone.
